1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.102.0.descrizione: sysUptime when agent last received an indication.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.103.0.descrizione: Number of notifications (traps|informs) sent that originated as CIM indication.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.104.0.descrizione: Number of CIM Indications that agent did not complete receipt of.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.105.0.descrizione: Number of CIM Indications having a MappingString qualifier for which the value was not a valid oid.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.106.0.descrizione: Number of CIM Indication properties having a MappingString qualifier for which the cim value for the given cim type could not be converted.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.107.0.descrizione: Number of CIM Indication properties having a MappingString qualifier for which the cim type could not be converted to smi syntax.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.108.0.descrizione: Number of CIM Indication properties having a MappingString qualifier for which the the oid was not valid.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.109.0.descrizione: Number of CIM GetClass operations over a given cim indication class and namespace could not be completed (timeout) or returned error.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.110.0.descrizione: Number of CIM indications having properties which do not have MappingString qualifier in the class definition and were not converted, sent along with the notification.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.20.111.0.descrizione: Number of CIM indications recieved for which GetClass reported no MappingStrings qualifier and were not converted to a notification.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.1.0.descrizione: A short description of the Indication.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.2.0.descrizione: The time and date the underlying event was first detected.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.3.0.descrizione: The time and date of creation of the underlying Indication received by the snmp agent.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.4.0.descrizione: An enumerated value that describes the severity of the Alert Indication from the notifier's point of view.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.6.0.descrizione: The scoping System's CreationClassName for the Provider generating this Indication.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.7.0.descrizione: The identifying information of the entity (ie, the instance) for which this notification is generated.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.8.0.descrizione: The format of the AlertingManagedElement property is interpretable based upon the value of this property.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.9.0.descrizione: The scoping System's Name for the Provider generating this message.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.4.30.10.0.descrizione: The name of the CIM provider, a software module loaded into the CIM subsystem, generating this message.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.50.101.0.descrizione: This holds the same value as vmwVmVMID of the affected vm generating the trap.

1.3.6.1.4.1.6876.50.102.0.descrizione: This is the path to the config file of the affected vm generating the trap and is same as vmwVmTable vmwVmConfigFile.

1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.4.1.0.descrizione: The authoritative identification of the notification currently being sent.

1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.4.3.0.descrizione: The authoritative identification of the enterprise associated with the trap currently being sent.

1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.6.1.0.descrizione: An advisory lock used to allow several cooperating command generator applications to coordinate their use of the SNMP set operation.
